gui.luna_npc.create_npc.title: Create NPC
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.natural_spawn.to: The NPC appears in the world on its own, in the biomes, structures and zones you set a chance for below. Placement follows its movement type (ground on land, water in water, air in open sky).
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.natural_spawn.hi: Turn on Natural spawning to have this NPC appear in the world on its own. Then give it a chance per biome, per structure, or inside a named zone — a higher chance means it spawns more often, just like a vanilla mob's spawn weight.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.spawn_loop_warni: ⚠ Natural spawning + Respawn keeps bringing this NPC back and spawning more — the population can climb without limit as you explore. Allowed, but cap it with Max nearby or a zone Max count.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.respawn.tooltip: After it dies, bring the NPC back after a random delay.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.respawn_at_death: On: reappears at its death spot. Off: reappears at its original spawn spot.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.max_nearby.toolt: Cap on how many of this NPC may be alive near players from biome/structure spawns (0 = unlimited).
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.surface_master.t: For biome and structure spawns: where this NPC may appear — Anywhere, only at the open Surface, or only in Caves (underground). Zones use their own per-zone setting. A best-effort check also keeps spawns out of player builds.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.spawn_global.too: ON: one spawn density covers every biome and dimension at once. OFF: pick biomes from the list and give each its own density. It is one or the other, never both.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.spawn_global.hin: One density for every biome and dimension.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.spawn_weight.too: How likely this NPC is to spawn here compared to everything else eligible — a relative chance, exactly like a vanilla mob's spawn weight. Example: 5 here while everything eligible totals 20 means a 5-in-20 chance. 0 = never.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.leave_area.toolt: On by default: the NPC roams freely like a vanilla mob. Turn OFF to tether it to the area it spawned in — the zone it appeared in, or a leash around its spawn point sized to its wander range — so it never wanders out.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.leave_area_comba: On by default: the NPC chases a target anywhere. Turn OFF to keep it from leaving its spawn area during a fight — it holds the line and, once the fight ends, returns to its area.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.persistent.toolt: On by default: a hand-placed or API-spawned NPC stays forever. Turn OFF to let it despawn like a normal mob once no player is nearby.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.spawn_persistent: OFF by default: a naturally-spawned NPC despawns like a normal mob, so wild spawns can't pile up. Turn ON to make every wild spawn permanent (population can grow without limit).
⚠ Persistent wild spawns never despawn — they pile up as you explore. Allowed, but cap it with Max nearby.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.zone_max.tooltip: The most of this NPC allowed alive in the zone at once (0 = unlimited). A killed NPC with respawn on still counts until it comes back.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.air_height.toolt: Fly-only: the world-height (Y) window a naturally-spawned flying NPC may appear in, clamped to the dimension's real height.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.air_above_ground: Fly-only: how far above the terrain a flying NPC spawns. Combined with Air height — the spawn Y is picked inside the overlap of the two windows.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.water_spawn_dept: Swim-only: how far below the water surface a naturally-spawned water NPC may appear — a shallow band keeps it near the top, a deep band pins it to the sea floor.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.spawn_none: No zones yet — make one with the Zone Wand
message.luna_npc.zone_point: Point %s set — right-click for more, sneak-right-click to finish
message.luna_npc.zone_need_points: A zone needs at least 3 points
gui.luna_npc.alliances.title: Alliances
gui.luna_npc.alliances.name: Name
gui.luna_npc.alliances.conflict: ⚠ Conflicting relations — allowed, but members may fight
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.gear_stats.warni: Gear now behaves like on a player — Combat values may be overridden or amplified
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.slot.head_items_: Shows heads, skulls and blocks; this model wears no armor
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.slot.main_hand.h: Held at close range and outside combat. With Gear Affects Stats, its damage and enchantments count for melee.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.slot.ranged_weap: Held only while fighting at long range, and sets the shot style: a bow draws, a crossbow loads, anything else throws. Empty keeps the main hand item. The flying projectile is set in the Combat tab.

gui.luna_npc.enchant.title: Enchant
gui.luna_npc.enchant.above_vanilla_any: ⚠ Some levels exceed the vanilla limit
gui.luna_npc.enchant.none: No enchantments available for this item
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.require_los.tool: The NPC only attacks when it can see the target, and repositions to get a clear line
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.difficulty_scali: On: world difficulty auto-adjusts the damage dealt (about half on Easy, +50% on Hard), like vanilla mobs. Off: the configured damage lands exactly, whatever the difficulty.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.give_up.tooltip: Drop a target that stays in range but takes no damage for this many seconds. Empty = never gives up
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.emergency_seek.t: When in bad light or burning, drop everything to find a safe spot right away instead of waiting for the next wander
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.reaction.tooltip: Aggressive: hunts enemies on sight, defends mates, fights back. Defensive: defends mates and fights back, but never hunts. Passive: only defends itself. Fearful: runs from any attacker.

gui.luna_npc.regen.condition.title: Regen Condition

gui.luna_npc.create_npc.curve.tooltip: The shot arcs downwards, bending 90° over the max distance
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.homing_warning: ⚠ Without homing, dodging targets may be missed
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.draw_held_warnin: Fire rate outpaces the draw — the bow/crossbow stays fully drawn
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.dynamic_accuracy: Accuracy follows the anchor curve; unchecked every shot uses the fixed accuracy
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.fixed_accuracy.t: How accurate every shot is, at any distance. 100% never misses
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.anchor_hint: Click the graph to add an anchor, drag to move
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.impact_destroy.t: Impacts blast a rough crater into the terrain
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.impact_radius.to: Radius of the crater and the particle area
gui.luna_npc.particle_picker.title: Select Particle
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.npc_type.alive.t: Potions affect this NPC like a player
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.npc_type.creatur: Potions affect this NPC like a creature such as a zombie
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.can_swim.tooltip: Unchecked: the NPC sinks in liquids and stops moving
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.can_open_doors.t: Paths through closed wooden doors: opens them, walks in, and closes them behind
Smashes through closed wooden doors like a zombie when it cannot open them
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.take_fall_damage: OFF by default so no NPC dies to fall damage — flyers that dip to the ground read as falling to the engine. Turn on for vanilla fall damage.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.projectile_immun: Every projectile passes straight through — no damage, effects, or knockback. Only the explosion of an explosive shot still hurts.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.fire_immune.tool: Takes no damage from any fire — burning, lava, magma blocks, and flame/fire-aspect hits — and never catches fire.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.avoid_light.tool: Won't pathfind into light brighter than the level and flees from it
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.avoid_night.tool: Won't pathfind into light darker than the level and flees from it
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.avoid_lava.toolt: Pathfinding never routes through lava — turn off at your own risk
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.tolerance.toolti: How far the NPC may drift from its preferred height
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.height_fixed.too: Checked: robotically holds the exact height. Unchecked: preferred height with tolerance, giving way to targets
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.leave_depth_comb: On: ignores its preferred depth in a fight and follows the target anywhere in the water (never above the surface). Off: only fights while the target is within its preferred depth (± tolerance) — leave that depth band and it won't attack.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.water_depth_tole: Hold-depth mode: how far above or below the preferred depth a target may be and still be fought. 0 = only at the exact depth
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.name: Name
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.no_equipment: This model can't show an item in this slot
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.knockback_warnin: ⚠ Negative values pull towards the attacker
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.min_goal_distanc: New walk points must be at least this many blocks away — capped by the radius
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.wander.static.to: Stands still and never wanders on its own
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.wander.stroll.to: Rests for a random interval, walks to a random point within the radius, then rests again
Walks all the time: the next random point starts the moment a walk ends
gui.luna_npc.pathfinding_picker.title: Select Pathfinding
gui.luna_npc.pathfinding.desc.vanilla: The same A* search Minecraft mobs use. Quick and cheap, but routes wobble and long ones get cut off.
gui.luna_npc.pathfinding.desc.enhanced: A* with diagonal moves and a far larger search budget. Reliable routes even at long range.
gui.luna_npc.pathfinding.desc.theta_star: Any-angle A*. Pulls routes into straight lines instead of grid staircases — the smoothest paths, at a price.
gui.luna_npc.pathfinding.desc.hierarchic: Plans a rough corridor first, then refines it piece by piece. Very cheap on long distances, slightly less precise.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.edit_access.gui_: Only this editor can change the NPC. Mods using the API can still read it, spawn it and react to it, but not change it.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.edit_access.shar: This editor and mods using the API can both change the NPC; whichever saves last wins. A mod that sets it up again on every start will overwrite your edits here.

gui.luna_npc.manage_permissions.offline_: Offline-mode server: UUIDs are derived from usernames. Without a 3rd-party auth system, anyone can take a granted player's identity.

gui.luna_npc.route.name: Name
gui.luna_npc.route.new.tooltip: Closes this screen. Then right-click the ground to place points, and sneak + right-click to finish.
gui.luna_npc.route.speed.tooltip: How NPCs move along this route: always walk, always run, or per point (each point sets the speed of the leg that leaves it). A patrol job can ignore this and set its own.
gui.luna_npc.route.empty: No routes yet. Press New Route, then right-click the ground to place points.
gui.luna_npc.route.look.tooltip: While waiting here, the NPC faces the direction below instead of looking around.
gui.luna_npc.route.face_me.tooltip: Use the direction you are facing right now
gui.luna_npc.route.leg_speed.tooltip: Whether the NPC walks or runs from this point to the next one.
gui.luna_npc.route.leg_speed.locked: Set the route's speed to Per point to choose this for each point.
gui.luna_npc.route.add_points.tooltip: Saves the route and closes this screen. Right-click the ground to add points to its end, then sneak + right-click.
gui.luna_npc.create_route.title: New Route
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.chunk_loader.too: Keeps the chunks around this NPC loaded while it lives, so it keeps walking (a patrol, a bodyguard) with no player nearby. Each loader keeps about 3x3 chunks running, so use it only where needed.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.chunk_loader_nat: ⚠ Chunk Loader with natural spawning on — every wild copy keeps its own chunks loaded, so the server load grows with the population.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.patrol_natural_w: ⚠ Patrol job with natural spawning on — wild spawns of this NPC appear without their job. Patrol works only on manually placed NPCs.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.patrol_no_route_: ⚠ No route to walk — add a patrol variant and pick a route for it, or the NPC just stands still.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.bodyguard_no_att: ⚠ Melee and ranged attacks are both off — it follows, but can't defend anyone. Turn on an attack in the Combat tab.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.bodyguard_nobody: ⚠ Protects nobody — pick players, alliances or NPCs, or switch it to "Whoever hires it".
gui.luna_npc.edit_patrol.title: Patrol Variant
gui.luna_npc.edit_patrol.no_routes: No routes yet — make one with the Route Creator stick.
gui.luna_npc.edit_patrol.mode.loop.toolt: Walks the points in order, then from the last straight back to the first.
Walks the points in order, then turns around at each end.
gui.luna_npc.edit_patrol.mode.random.too: Picks any other point of the route as the next one.
gui.luna_npc.edit_patrol.speed.tooltip: Keep the walk/run speeds saved on the route, or ignore them and always walk or always run.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.title: Bodyguard
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.npcs.tooltip: LunaNPC NPCs it protects. The list shows the NPCs from the last time you opened the Edit or Spawn stick; add any other by its LID below.
How close it keeps to the one it protects. It never stands on their exact spot, and drifts around inside this radius while they stand still.
It runs to catch up and walks once it is this close.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.teleport.too: Snaps within 3 blocks of the one it protects when left this far behind or in another dimension, like a tamed wolf. Off = it gives up once they are beyond its range.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.defense.tool: How long it fights whoever hurt the one it protects: a time, or until the attacker is dead.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.assist.toolt: Also attacks whatever the one it protects attacks.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.retreat.tool: Drops a fight that pulls it too far away and runs back.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.retreat_dist: How far it may get from the one it protects (or from its post when told to stay) before it retreats.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.friendly_fir: Whether the ones it guards can hurt it — whoever hired it, or anyone matching its chosen targets. No = their hits, arrows and accidents do nothing to it. Everyone else can still hurt it.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.hire_seconds: How long one hire lasts; also the default for dialog and command hires. 0 = until it gives up.
gui.luna_npc.bodyguard.hire_hint: It follows you and fights whoever hurts you. Right-click it later to give it orders.
gui.luna_npc.dialog.action.give_bodyguar: 0 uses the bodyguard job's own hire time.
Spawns %s next to the player. If its job is Bodyguard, it is hired for the player.
Enter the LID of the NPC to give.
gui.luna_npc.dialog.action.order.hint: Applies to every bodyguard the player has hired.
message.luna_npc.bodyguard_released.died: %s stopped guarding you after your death
message.luna_npc.bodyguard_released.out_: %s lost you and stopped guarding you
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.bodyguard_range_: ⚠ Its range is no wider than its stay or walk distance — without teleporting it gives up as soon as its protectee steps away.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.bodyguard_telepo: ⚠ Teleport distance is within its stay radius or the 3 blocks it lands within — it keeps teleporting while just standing guard.
gui.luna_npc.create_npc.bodyguard_retrea: ⚠ Retreat distance is no wider than its stay radius — it drops every fight right away.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.source.toolt: One choice: it either picks from the targets you choose, or waits until a player hires it. Dialogs and /lunanpc bodyguard can hire it either way.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.source.targe: Guards the closest of these within its range and stays with them until they die, leave its range or it is dismissed. To protect every player, pick an alliance that matches all players.
Waits until a player pays the price. It then guards only them (nobody else can hire it meanwhile) and takes their orders: follow, stay, go home or dismiss.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.range.toolti: It picks someone to protect within this distance and gives them up once they get farther away. With teleporting on, it never loses them by distance.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.alliances.to: Members of these alliances. An alliance that matches all players covers every player.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.keep_after_d: Keep protecting: it finishes its fight and waits for a player to respawn. NPCs and mobs never come back, so it always gives up on them.
gui.luna_npc.edit_bodyguard.give_up.tool: After it lets go (dismissed, hire over, its protectee died, left or got out of range): stay where it is, walk home, or despawn. It then looks for, or waits for, the next one.
